zh.title: 历史能源数据的可运行模型
zh.summary: 在9个合成缺失场景上增加三组阈值敏感性矩阵，并把“绝对均值偏差≥1%”暂定为合成材料性标签。严格规则的精确率0.60、召回率0.75；平衡与敏感规则均为0.667和1.00。结果说明阈值选择会改变漏报，但三组都有2个误报；只可用于选择真实数据试验方案。
zh.currentQuestion: 真实96行场站数据是否仍支持1%材料性标签，三组规则的误报和漏报会如何变化？
zh.todayMaterial: scripts/test-sample-error-budget.mjs v3：strict/balanced/sensitive三阈值、混淆矩阵、精确率与召回率；全部明确为合成校准。
zh.next: 下一成果：取得授权真实导出后预注册材料性阈值，盲算三组规则并与缺失率单规则比较。
zh.unfinished: 没有真实场站数据；1%标签、0.8负荷分位和6行连续缺口都不是经验有效阈值。

en.title: Runnable Models for Historical Energy Data
en.summary: Added a three-rule threshold-sensitivity matrix to the nine synthetic missingness scenarios, temporarily defining material synthetic error as absolute mean bias of at least 1%. Strict precision/recall are 0.60/0.75; balanced and sensitive are both 0.667/1.00. Threshold choice changes misses, while every rule produces two false positives; this only selects a real-data experiment.
en.currentQuestion: Will real 96-row site data support the 1% materiality label, and how will false positives and negatives change?
en.todayMaterial: scripts/test-sample-error-budget.mjs v3: strict, balanced, and sensitive thresholds with confusion matrices, precision, and recall, all marked synthetic.
en.next: Next output: preregister materiality on an authorized export, blind-run all three rules, and compare with a missing-rate-only rule.
en.unfinished: No real-site data exists; 1% materiality, 0.8 load percentile, and a six-row gap are not empirically valid thresholds.
